name: Bureau Works TMGMT Connector
description: a TMGMT translator connector for the Bureau Works translation platform.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 The wxrks TMGMT Connector integrates Drupal with wxrks Translation Management System via the TMGMT module.

 It allows Drupal site builders and content editors to submit content for translation, track job status, and retrieve translated content directly within Drupal, using wxrks’ context-first, AI-powered localization platform.

 The module can be used either as a standalone Drupal integration or as part of the broader wxrks Translation Management System, which supports over 40 file types and enterprise-scale localization workflows.

 wxrks is trusted by global organizations such as Coca-Cola, Harley-Davidson, Scaled Agile, Automation Anywhere, Uber, and Zendesk.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 This module provides the following functionality:

 
 Adds wxrks as a Translation Provider in TMGMT 
 Allows submitting Drupal content for translation directly from the TMGMT UI 
 Supports contextual translation workflows powered by wxrks’ LLM-assisted platform 
 Enables job status tracking and delivery back into Drupal 
 Supports enterprise-grade translation workflows, permissions, and quality controls 
 
 Back to top 

 Typical use cases include: 
 
 Multilingual Drupal sites using TMGMT 
 Enterprise and marketing websites with frequent content updates 
 Agencies managing localization for multiple Drupal clients 
 Organizations needing scalable, AI-assisted translation workflows 
 
 Back to top 

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires:

 
 Compatibility: Drupal 10.5+, PHP 8.3+, Drupal 11 
 Dependency: TMGMT 8.x-1.15+ 
 A valid wxrks subscription 
 
 No additional PHP libraries are required beyond Drupal and TMGMT.

 Back to top 

 Recommended Modules / Libraries 
 - TMGMT (required)

- Other TMGMT submodules (optional), depending on your translation workflow

 Back to top

 Unlike traditional solutions, wxrks offers a fully automated, AI-driven approach that adapts to your content needs while integrating effortlessly with your existing Drupal workflow:
